dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical convex narrowing from the maximal width of the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and free of localized asymmetrical structural deviations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches distributed along the lateral margins and posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the lighter central dorsal area and slightly darker lateral patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, low-contrast dark points are visible on the mid-dorsal and anterior surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A longitudinal linear crease is visible along the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct longitudinal linear mark or indentation is present on the posterior dorsal axis.
